tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: Lists all GCS buckets in the project.

project_id.description: The project ID to list buckets for.

tools.name: get_bucket_location
tools.description: Gets the location and storage class of a bucket.

tools.name: get_bucket_metadata
tools.description: Gets detailed metadata for a specific bucket.

tools.name: view_iam_policy
tools.description: Views the IAM policy for a bucket.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

tools.name: check_iam_permissions
tools.description: Tests IAM permissions for a bucket.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Creates a new bucket with specified configuration.

project_id.description: The ID of the GCP project.

bucket_name.description: The name of the bucket to create.

storage_class.description: The storage class for the bucket.

labels.description: Labels to apply to the bucket.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: Lists the names of objects in a Google Cloud Storage (GCS) bucket. Supports filtering by prefix, directory-like listing with a delimiter, pagination, and listing object versions.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

prefix.description: Filters results to objects whose names begin with this prefix.

delimiter.description: Can be used to list objects in a directory-like structure. For example, using a delimiter of '/' will return objects at the root level and not in subdirectories. This helps in navigating virtual folder hierarchies.

max_results.description: The maximum number of object names to return in a single response. If not specified, the API defaults to 1,000. The maximum value allowed is also 1,000.

page_token.description: A token used to retrieve the next page of results. This is obtained from the `next_page_token` field of a previous `list_objects` call.

versions.description: If true, lists all versions of an object as distinct results.

tools.name: read_object_content
tools.description: Reads the content of a specific object.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

tools.name: read_object_metadata
tools.description: Reads metadata for a specific object.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

tools.name: get_metadata_table_schema
tools.description: Checks if GCS insights service is enabled and returns the BigQuery table schema for a given insights dataset configuration in JSON format. Also returns hints for each column in the table

datasetConfigName.description: The name of the dataset configuration.

datasetConfigLocation.description: The location of the dataset configuration.

projectId.description: The project ID to check Storage Insights availability for.

tools.name: execute_insights_query
tools.description: Executes a BigQuery SQL query against an insights dataset and returns the result.

config.description: The JSON object of the BigQuery table schema for a given insights dataset configuration.

query.description: The BigQuery SQL query to execute.

jobTimeoutMs.description: The maximum amount of time for the job to run on the server.

tools.name: list_insights_configs
tools.description: Lists the names of all Storage Insights dataset configurations for a given project.

projectId.description: The project ID to list Storage Insights dataset configurations for.

tools.name: write_object_safe
tools.description: Writes a new object to the bucket. Fails if the object already exists.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

object_name.description: The name of the object to write.

content.description: The content to write to the object, encoded in base64.

content_type.description: The content type of the object.

tools.name: upload_object_safe
tools.description: Uploads a file to a GCS bucket. Fails if the object already exists.

bucket_name.description: The name of the GCS bucket.

file_path.description: The local path of the file to upload.

object_name.description: The name of the object in GCS. If not provided, the filename from file_path will be used.

content_type.description: The content type of the object.

tools.name: copy_object_safe
tools.description: Copies an object to a new destination. Fails if an object already exists at the destination.

source_bucket_name.description: The name of the source GCS bucket.

source_object_name.description: The name of the source object.

destination_bucket_name.description: The name of the destination GCS bucket.

destination_object_name.description: The name for the copied object.
